title: Naftali Kempeh Concert Canceled
body: VMP canceled Naftali Kempeh's Yerushalayim concert amid threats, planned disruptions, and public backlash over the singer's new album release celebration.

title: Rav Yaakov Sofer Passes Away
body: Rav Yaakov Sofer zt”l, son of the Imrei Sofer, passed away at 77 after a difficult illness. He served as Rav of the Erlau community in Beitar Illit.
